create_demo_header_component: create a DemoHeader DashComponent that renders a header row with a stream counter and title
register_callbacks_demo_header: register callbacks on a DemoHeader to display interval counts and toggle streaming on or off

test_toggle_interval: test the toggle_interval function to pause or unpause the svm_watcher and toggle button text
